name: Quick Commit
_hypothesis: Aggressive already commits sooner with less (attackTimeoutMult 0.55, armyAttackSizeMult 0.6) at the cost of a thin home guard (garrisonMult 0.4). This candidate pushes the timing/muster dials further still, but spends less of that saved ore on home defense than Aggressive gives up — testing whether committing EVEN earlier only pays off if you also keep more of a garrison, or whether Aggressive's own trade-off was already close to the efficient point.
